evidence.excerpt: Horizon3.ai press release, 7 Jan 2026 (search summary; page blocked to the sandbox): Andres Botero appointed Chief Marketing Officer to lead global marketing strategy; most recently CMO at Rubrik, where subscription ARR doubled to over $1B and the company completed its April 2024 IPO (NYSE: RBRK).

Horizon3 press release via Business Wire, 3 Aug 2026 (search summary): $250M Series E at a valuation of more than $2B, oversubscribed, co-led by existing investors NightDragon and NEA, tripling the $650M Series D valuation in just over a year; seven new and five returning investors.

SecurityWeek and the company release, 3 Aug 2026: new investors Acrew Capital, Blue Cloud Ventures, Demeter Group, EDBI (Singapore), PSG, SAIC and Sapphire Ventures; existing investors Craft Ventures, Prosperity7 Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures, Ridge Ventures and SignalFire participated.

Company release: 120% year-on-year ARR growth; more than 7,000 organisations protected, four of them Fortune 10 enterprises. TechCrunch, 3 Aug 2026: roughly 7,200–7,300 customers and ARR approaching $100M (reported).

TechCrunch, 3 Aug 2026: the Series E triples the $650M valuation set at the $100M Series D led by NEA in June 2025 (Business Wire, 10 Jun 2025: Series D with SignalFire, Craft Ventures, 9Yards Capital).

TechCrunch, 3 Aug 2026: San Francisco-based; founders Snehal Antani (CEO) and Anthony Pillitiere met while serving at Joint Special Operations Command. Antani was previously CTO at US Special Operations Command, CTO of Splunk and a CIO within GE Capital (Cybersecurity Summit speaker profile).

TechCrunch, 3 Aug 2026: the funding backs international expansion, with a new Amsterdam office opened in June 2026 and offices in Australia and Singapore, a partner network build-out and continued R&D spend.

Horizon3.ai press release, 19 Aug 2025: Holly Grey appointed Chief Financial Officer (previously CFO of Exabeam). Company listings: Matt Hartley, Chief Revenue Officer; Jill Passalacqua, Chief Legal Officer. No president or COO is listed.

McLaren Racing, 28 Jan 2026: multi-year partnership with Rubrik as Official Partner of the McLaren Mastercard F1 Team and the Arrow McLaren IndyCar Team. Botero was Rubrik's CMO from June 2023 (Rubrik press release) until his move to Horizon3 announced 7 Jan 2026; his role in the McLaren deal is not confirmed by any source.

Forbes and Sportcal, Nov 2025: Cadillac F1 named Lauren Teixeira chief commercial officer and Willem Dinger chief partnerships officer, reporting to Tyler Epp (global head of commercial strategy), alongside CMO Ahmed Iqbal; the team describes a 'fewer, bigger, better' partnership ecosystem. Operations in Fishers (Indiana), Charlotte (North Carolina) and Silverstone (UK); GM and TWG backed; 2026 is its debut season.

Business Wire, 4 Feb 2026: TWG AI becomes primary and exclusive AI partner of the Cadillac Formula 1 Team (multi-year). Core Scientific is Official Data Center Partner (10 Mar 2026); IFS is official technology partner for ERP, procurement, supply chain and engineering management.

CloudSEK, Aug 2025: threats targeting F1 fans and teams ahead of the Dutch GP included AI deepfakes impersonating executives, phishing and telemetry data theft; researchers exposed an FIA systems loophole in June 2025 (Panda Security).

Sponsor table: Mercedes — CrowdStrike, Microsoft; Ferrari — Bitdefender; Red Bull — 1Password, Oracle; Williams — Keeper; McLaren — Okta, Cisco (Splunk), Rubrik (joined 2026); Alpine — Cato Networks, SEALSQ (joined 2026), Microsoft; Audi — NinjaOne, Extreme Networks, Admin By Request departed; Aston Martin — SentinelOne marked departed within the last 12 months (no end announced live, treated as occupied); Racing Bulls — Dynatrace, Confluent; Haas — Mphasis (services); Cadillac — TWG AI, Core Scientific, IFS, no cybersecurity partner.
2026 F1 calendar table: United States GP (round 19, Austin, late October), Mexico City GP (round 20), São Paulo GP (round 21), Las Vegas GP (round 22, November).

brief.hq: San Francisco (offices in Amsterdam, Australia, Singapore)
brief.deck: Horizon3, the San Francisco security company whose NodeZero platform attacks customers' networks the way an adversary would, announced a $250M Series E at a valuation above $2B on 3 August, co-led by NightDragon and NEA, tripling the $650M price of its June 2025 Series D in little over a year.
brief.the_case_p1: The oversubscribed round brought in Acrew, Blue Cloud Ventures, Demeter, Singapore's EDBI, PSG, SAIC and Sapphire, with Craft, Prosperity7, Qualcomm Ventures, Ridge and SignalFire returning. The company reports 120% year-on-year ARR growth and more than 7,000 organisations protected, four of them Fortune 10; TechCrunch puts ARR near $100M (reported). Founders Snehal Antani and Anthony Pillitiere met at Joint Special Operations Command; Antani was later CTO of Splunk. The money funds international expansion, with offices opened in Amsterdam in June, Australia and Singapore, and a partner network.
brief.the_case_p2: Cybersecurity is the most-sold technology category on the grid: CrowdStrike at Mercedes, Bitdefender at Ferrari, Keeper at Williams, Okta and Rubrik at McLaren, Cato Networks at Alpine, and Red Bull's 1Password. Every one sells defence. Horizon3 sells the attack, continuously, and its new CMO Andres Botero ran marketing at Rubrik in the period its McLaren partnership was being built. A category leader with no seat, and a marketer who has watched one taken.
brief.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The round closed on 3 August, a CMO arrived in January with a category-leadership mandate, and offices are opening on three continents. The United States GP in Austin (late October) and Las Vegas (November) fall inside the window, and teams close 2027 rosters in the fourth quarter.
brief.why_team_para: Cadillac is the American debutant building its technology roster from scratch under a stated 'fewer, bigger, better' partner policy: IFS runs the enterprise stack, Core Scientific the data centre, TWG AI the exclusive AI programme. It carries no cybersecurity partner, so Official Cybersecurity Partner is cleanly ownable. A first-season estate across Fishers, Charlotte and Silverstone has never been tested in anger, and Horizon3's defence-rooted American story suits a GM-backed flag-bearer.
brief.value_content: MODE A - operational. NodeZero runs autonomous penetration tests continuously across the team's estate: the Fishers and Silverstone factory networks, the garage network rebuilt at every circuit, supplier and partner integrations, and the Core Scientific and TWG AI environments. Findings are ranked by exploitability and re-tested after each fix, so a small security staff works on what an attacker would actually use.
brief.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Cybersecurity Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, 2027-2029, spanning the international build-out. Estimated $4-6M a year, part-payable in NodeZero licences. Scope: car and garage placement, naming of the team's security-validation programme, Austin and Las Vegas hospitality for CISOs and federal buyers, content on how a new team defends itself.
brief.decision_maker_bio: Botero joined on 7 January 2026 from Rubrik, where he was CMO through its April 2024 IPO and while the McLaren partnership announced on 28 January was built; his part in that deal is not confirmed. Sponsor: Snehal Antani, co-founder and CEO. Path: Holly Grey, CFO, and Matt Hartley, CRO.
brief.opening_angle_intro: Lead with Rubrik and the empty lane.
brief.opening_angle_quote: “Andres, you were at Rubrik while its McLaren deal came together. Cadillac has no cybersecurity partner and a first-season estate nobody has attacked yet. 25 minutes before Austin to see what NodeZero on a Formula 1 team looks like?”
score_cells: Round announced 3 Aug; Austin and Las Vegas inside the window.
American, defence-rooted B2B brand; CISO and federal audience.
Expansion and new CMO, but no listing date or hard deadline.
MODE A: continuous autonomous pentesting of a new estate.
risks: TWG AI is Cadillac's exclusive AI partner; an 'AI vs AI' security brand could be read as an AI partner and blocked.
Enter as cybersecurity, position NodeZero as security validation, and clear the language with TWG first.
Horizon3 has never run a sports partnership, and Cadillac's 'fewer, bigger, better' policy is priced for large cheques.
Use Botero's Rubrik playbook and pay part of the fee in licences the team would otherwise buy.
brief.bottom_line: $250M at more than $2B, 120% ARR growth, a CMO who has seen an F1 deal built and an open cybersecurity lane at the American debutant put Horizon3 at peak authority to move, with Austin and Las Vegas inside the window. The TWG AI exclusivity and a premium first-deal price hold the score at 78.

why_now.label: Trigger
why_now.text: Horizon3 announced a $250M Series E at a valuation above $2B on 3 August 2026, co-led by NightDragon and NEA, with seven new investors including Sapphire Ventures, PSG, SAIC and Singapore's EDBI. The company release and TechCrunch carry the same figures.

why_now.label: Tripled in a year
why_now.text: The June 2025 Series D, $100M led by NEA, valued the company at $650M (reported). Fourteen months later the price is above $2B, on 120% year-on-year ARR growth and more than 7,000 organisations protected, four of them Fortune 10. A brand re-rated that fast has a story to tell and the budget to tell it.

why_now.label: A marketing owner with a mandate
why_now.text: Andres Botero joined as Chief Marketing Officer on 7 January 2026 from Rubrik, where he was CMO through the April 2024 IPO. Rubrik's multi-year McLaren partnership was announced three weeks after his move; whether he built it is not confirmed, but he has seen the mechanics from the inside.

why_now.label: Calendar window
why_now.text: The United States GP in Austin (late October) and the Las Vegas GP (November) are the two US rounds left in 2026, with Mexico City and São Paulo between them; teams close 2027 partner rosters in the fourth quarter. A deal agreed before Austin can be announced there and activated in full for 2027.

why_team.label: The open lane
why_team.text: Cadillac's debut roster carries TWG AI as exclusive AI partner, Core Scientific for the data centre, IFS for enterprise software, plus Claro, Jim Beam, Tenneco and Tommy Hilfiger. No cybersecurity partner: Official Cybersecurity Partner is a clean category on a team that has said it wants fewer, bigger partners.

why_team.label: A greenfield estate
why_team.text: New factories in Fishers, Charlotte and Silverstone, a supplier base assembled in two years and a garage network rebuilt at every circuit. F1 teams have faced phishing, deepfake and telemetry-theft campaigns and a 2025 FIA systems loophole. A first-season estate is the one most in need of continuous attack testing.

why_team.label: An American story
why_team.text: Horizon3's founders met at Joint Special Operations Command and SAIC has joined the register. Cadillac is the GM-backed American flag-bearer with a commercial team hired from the Miami GP and Unilever to sell exactly that audience.

why_team.label: The buyer in the suite
why_team.text: Cadillac's hospitality reaches CISOs, CIOs and federal buyers at Austin and Las Vegas, the audience a $100M-ARR security company selling to Fortune 10 accounts wants in the room.

value.label: Operational workstream (Mode A)
value.text: NodeZero runs autonomous penetration tests continuously across the team's factory networks, trackside infrastructure, supplier integrations and partner environments, ranking findings by exploitability and re-testing after each fix. The team's security staff work from a live attacker's view rather than an annual audit.

value.label: Commercial lift for the team
value.text: A partner that sells to Fortune 10 CISOs and defence agencies brings a guest list of security and federal buyers to the US rounds, the audience Cadillac's B2B partners want alongside them.

value.label: Content and ecosystem
value.text: How a brand-new Formula 1 team defends itself: co-produced engineering content on continuous security validation, a reference customer for Horizon3's enterprise sales, and a story that fits a debutant building everything from scratch.

value.label: What the team gives back
value.text: Official Cybersecurity Partner designation, car and garage placement, naming of the security-validation programme, Austin and Las Vegas hospitality, driver and engineering access for Horizon3's channels.

ruled_out.reason: CrowdStrike has held the cybersecurity lane since 2019; Microsoft also on the roster.
1Password holds security; Oracle is title partner.
Keeper Security holds identity and access security.
Okta, Cisco with Splunk, and Rubrik (joined 2026) crowd the security lane; Botero's former employer sits there.
Cato Networks and SEALSQ joined for 2026; Microsoft on the roster.
NinjaOne and Extreme Networks cover IT management and networking; Admin By Request departed within the year.
SentinelOne is marked as departed within the last 12 months in the sponsor table, but no end has been announced; treated as occupied.

ruled_out.team: TGR Haas F1 Team · Visa Cash App Racing Bulls
ruled_out.reason: Open but not chosen: neither offers the American greenfield estate and premium positioning that match a $2B company.

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Andres Botero before the United States GP to test appetite for a 2027 start, clear the AI-partner language with Cadillac's TWG AI exclusivity, and size an Official Cybersecurity Partner entry, part-paid in NodeZero licences, against the team's 2027 roster.

# Horizon3.ai → Cadillac F1 Team — verification log (N° 154, issued for 3 Aug 2026)

Built in-session at no API cost (no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the sandbox) from the batch-6 row

securityweek.com, mclaren.com and forbes.com were blocked by the egress proxy. Every claim was

  "European HQ" label is not used in the copy.
- **Decision-maker changed** from the row's Snehal Antani (CEO) to **Andres Botero, CMO**,
  appointed 7 Jan 2026: the real sponsorship owner. Antani is the C-level sponsor in the path.
